# Feature Request

## Feature Summary

Describe the feature you want to add.

Example:

```text
Add real-time chat between client and freelancer after a proposal is accepted.
```

---

## Problem It Solves

Explain why this feature is useful.

```text
Currently, clients and freelancers cannot communicate inside the platform after project assignment.
```

---

## Proposed Solution

Describe how the feature should work.

```text
After a client accepts a proposal, a chat room should be created for that project.
Both client and assigned freelancer should be able to send messages.
```

---

## User Role Affected

Select the affected role:

```text
Client
Freelancer
Admin
Both Client and Freelancer
System
```

---

```text
Authentication

```
